messages:
jon: Heads-up: we have an RBAC change planned for Wednesday 02:00 UTC that widens access to the on-prem KMS key for the private deployment operator role. I want to sync on audit logging + network isolation implications before we run it.

maria: +1. Which key exactly? and which role? this touches customer-managed keystores for EU customers.

jon: key id: kms-prod-priv-edge-01, role: private-deploy-operator. The change allows role to call Decrypt for bootstrap workflows.

eli: risky if there isn't fine-grained logging. We need object-level audit entries (who/what/key) and an alert on any Decrypt calls from unexpected hosts.

priya: Agree. Can we add an allow-list for the jumpbox IPs and require mTLS from hosts? Also netpol should block pod->kms except from the operator namespace.

jon: Good point. Current netpol only allows namespace selector "operator-ns" -> egress tcp 443. We should tighten to label/selector on pods + require TLS SNI check at the proxy.

sasha: For replay risk: if operator role is scripted, ensure request nonces & short-lived session tokens. If a key unwrap happens, we should log the request id and the session id.

maria: For audit retention, legal wants 1 year for priv deployments. Storage is fine, but we need indexing for fast queries (by key, by subject). Can we shard logs by customer-id?

eli: Yes. Suggest adding an index field "customer_id" at ingestion + export to GCS bucket with lifecycle 18mo, and daily integrity hashes.

sec-bot: Reminder: there's an outstanding vuln (CVE-2024-xxxxx) in the KMS agent published 2 weeks ago. Patch available in 2.1.3. Current private nodes run 2.1.1.

jon: Thanks. We need to triage: does the CVE allow key exfil? What mitigations until upgrade?

priya: Preliminary triage: local privilege escalation in the agent, requires container-level access. Attack path would need pod compromise. Mitigation: network segmentation + dropping capability CAP_SYS_ADMIN on the agent container.

maria: Can we schedule a rolling patch with a canary (single region) and automated smoke tests? Also we should add an emergency rollback runbook that revokes operator role from the MSP if we see suspicious decrypts.

eli: Proposed rollout steps in brief:
1) Add netpol rule restricting egress to specific endpoint fqdn + require mTLS;
2) Deploy audit logging schema change (customer_id, session_id, request_id);
3) Patch agent to 2.1.3 on canary hosts; run decrypt/integrity smoke;
4) If smoke fails, run rollback: revoke private-deploy-operator from key policy and direct traffic to dedicated-hosted fallback.

sasha: For rollback we need automated key policy change script. I can add a small tool that posts a signed request to the control plane to remove role binding. Needs human-in-loop escalation.

jon: Who can own the key-policy revocation script and be oncall Wed 02:00 UTC?

maria: I can be oncall for the first two hours. eli can take follow-ups. priy a will help with the netpol updates. sasha + sec on standby for rollback script.

priya: Small netpol snippet I propose:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: restrict-kms-egress
  namespace: operator-ns
spec:
  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: operator } }
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.10.20.0/24 # jumpbox/net-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

eli: Also add a deny-by-default policy in adjacent namespaces so nothing else can talk out.

sec-bot: Audit checklist updated: https://confluence.internal/security/priv-deploy-audit (automated entry).

jon: Thanks. Action items:
- sasha: tool to revoke role binding (PR by EOD Mon)
- maria/eli: implement audit schema & ingestion (PR + test harness)
- priya: netpol + capability drop change (PR + rollout plan)
- ops: schedule canary patch for Tue 22:00 UTC, full roll on Wed 02:00 UTC if canary green.

maria: I'll create the smoke tests: decrypt roundtrip + log verify + integrity hash compare.

eli: I'll add alert rule: any Decrypt from unexpected IP or >3 decrypts/min from same session -> pager.

sasha: PR submitted for revocation tool: https://git.internal/r/revoke-tool/pull/7 (wip). includes signed webhook + audit event emit.

jon: Great. One more: update customer communication template for affected priv deployments in case of incident. I'll draft and share.

maria: thumbs up. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: RBAC change will be applied 2025-05-14 02:00 UTC. Change id: rb-20250514-kms-access. CI checks required: netpol-lint, audit-schema-tests.

jon: Closing: we will reconvene Tue 18:00 UTC for pre-flight. If anyone sees a blocker earlier, ping here.

sec-bot: Note: create an evidence bucket with restricted ACLs for any incident artifacts.
